# gramlot-js-server 0.3.25

Aligns Node/Bun hosting, Worker/file export and project creation with the reviewed core and gallery. Serves the shared lazy Markdown asset and retains isolated component sanitization policies, uploader/Visual Editor integration and environment-provided collections.

One-file and directory serverless exports include their required runtime resources and were exercised directly from disk. Database experiments specific to the Python/Asqueel host are not advertised as Worker capabilities.

Invoice application and Python compiled-page export remain excluded. No TestFlight upload is included.
